split_rule: Beer-level style-stratified splits; every raw taster/presentation record follows its beer. Inner split seed = outer seed+100+outer fold. No choice uses outer validation labels.
model_seed_rule: 20261026+repeat_index*1000+outer_fold*100+inner_fold for inner fits, +99 for final outer-training fits.
Q1_point: Freeze the adopted R2/R2b Extra Trees integer conditional median plus parent cap. Do not reopen failed tail-cost tuning or search the older candidate family. Compare training-only pooled median.
Q1_risk: Repeat the R2b training-inner-OOF uncalibrated nonzero Brier source selection over prior/Extra Trees/raw ordinal, then fit the existing six sigmoid recalibrators only on those inner OOF values and outer-training labels. Preserve calibrated and selected-uncalibrated outputs and reliability diagnostics.
Q2: Repeat R3 global inner-OOF raw-rating-MAE GBR depth1/depth2 selection and fixed alpha=1000 raw-mean Ridge comparator. Exact interventional SHAP only on outer-validation beers, 100 distinct outer-training background beers. No zero-score rank filling or physical/causal interpretation.
Q3: Keep deployed interpolation fixed. In addition repeat the existing interpolation/copula replacement gate solely on each outer training set's two inner folds, then evaluate both fixed candidates and this inner-selected workflow on the untouched outer fold. No outer-score-based replacement or tuning.
generation_seed_rule: 20261026+repeat*10000+outer_fold*1000+(inner_fold+1)*100+style_index for inner samples; use +900+style_index for outer samples. Fit copula marginals only for the three requested generation styles, with imputation fitted on all current training beers.
rank_scope: 219 strict analytes and a separate 220-candidate IBU family supplement. Report per-repeat global ranks, per-fold ranks, within-repeat and between-repeat Jaccard. Overlapping refit frequencies are not independent selection probabilities. Do not transfer older P/q values.
uncertainty: Report all three repeat metrics and mean/sample-SD/range. For paired fixed-OOF bootstrap intervals average each beer's loss difference over repeats first, then resample the 250 beers within styles. Do not treat the 750 repeated predictions as independent. MAE uses 95%, five defect nonzero Brier uses 99%; no intervention or full training-selection uncertainty coverage claimed.
migration: No migration search, anchor choice, weight tuning or success certification. Retain Task4 zero fully checked candidates. Optionally evaluate the eleven already frozen prepared before/after spectra using the source beer's held-out outer model in each repeat. These paths used historical full-data selection/preparation, so this is explicitly conditional sensitivity, not nested migration generalization or measured intervention validation.
deployment: Do not replace Q1/Q2/Q3 deployment artifacts from repeat scores. This is evaluation of frozen methods/selection rules. Two unlabelled acetaldehyde targets and their rank slots remain blank.
scope: Task5 only, post-development reuse of the same 250 beers, 226 measured plus five derived fields with the same 224 modeled predictors. No external independent test, causal confirmation, paper writing or Task6 integration.
